description: End-to-end telco alarm notification and communication workflow from alarm ingestion to notification delivery, acknowledgement, and recovery handling.

alarm_id.description: Unique identifier of an alarm in the assurance system

correlation_id.description: Identifier used to correlate multiple alarms into a single incident or notification context

incident_id.description: Identifier for a grouped incident derived from one or more alarms

notification_id.description: Identifier of a notification instance sent to subscribers

subscriber_id.description: Identifier of a user, team, or system subscribed to notifications

channel_id.description: Identifier for a communication channel configuration (email, SMS, webhook, etc.)

policy_id.description: Identifier for a notification or routing policy

functions.name: ingest_alarm_event

source.description: Information about the originating source of the alarm

system_name.description: Name of the originating system (e.g., OSS, EMS)

vendor.description: Vendor name of the originating network element or system

region.description: Geographical or logical region of the source

alarm_details.description: Technical details of the ingested alarm

correlation_hint.description: Hints that may help to correlate this alarm with existing incidents

existing_correlation_id.description: If known, a correlation ID to attach to

topology_keys.description: List of topology dimensions for correlation (e.g., site, cell, tech)

functions.name: correlate_alarms_to_incident

manual_context.description: Additional context when correlation is manually triggered

alarm_snapshot.description: Snapshot of alarm attributes used for templating

incident_summary.description: Summary of incident (e.g., affected sites, services)

functions.name: acknowledge_alarm_or_incident
